rules.title: App Router requires React 19
rules.notes: The Pages Router may stay on React 18. The match is an app-router file, and the engine still applies the requirement when that match finds nothing, with a note that it may not be needed.
rules.verify_hint: Load the affected page or run the build, and confirm the new behaviour.
rules.rollback_hint: Return to the previous release of the library.
rules.concern: The App Router requires react and react-dom 19. The Pages Router can stay on 18.

rules.title: runtime configuration (Breaking change)
rules.verify_hint: Load the affected page or run the build, and confirm the new behaviour.
rules.rollback_hint: Return to the previous release of the library.
rules.concern: Segment config runtime: 'experimental-edge' is rejected; use 'edge'.

rules.title: fetch requests
rules.notes: Left draft in the 2026-10-20 review: the section supports the rule, but a call rule needs an indirect seeded case and the finder reports fetch only at the call itself, not at callers of a fetch helper. Close the gap in the finder first (D29).
rules.verify_hint: Load the affected page or run the build, and confirm the new behaviour.
rules.rollback_hint: Return to the previous release of the library.
rules.concern: fetch is no longer cached by default.

mapping.to: fetch(url, { cache: 'force-cache' }) when the old cached behaviour is required

rules.title: Route Handlers
rules.verify_hint: Load the affected page or run the build, and confirm the new behaviour.
rules.rollback_hint: Return to the previous release of the library.
rules.concern: GET route handlers are no longer cached by default.

mapping.to: export const dynamic = 'force-static' when the old cached behaviour is required

rules.title: Client Cache
rules.notes: Left draft in the 2026-10-20 review: the match binds experimental.staleTimes, the opt-in the section offers, so it only finds apps that have already handled the change. The affected code (Link and useRouter navigation) is not reported by the finder.
rules.verify_hint: Load the affected page or run the build, and confirm the new behaviour.
rules.rollback_hint: Return to the previous release of the library.
rules.concern: Page segments are no longer reused from the client cache on Link or useRouter navigation.

mapping.to: experimental.staleTimes when the old reuse is required

rules.notes: The same removal is defined in release 14 (next/the-next-font-package-has-been-fully-removed-in-favor-of-the). This file records it again as a later removed event, so an install already on 14 still sees it. This draft has no match of its own.
